description: NVDB-VISQ is a dataset listed in Geodata Portal Sweden, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.trafikverket.se. An application where you can see the results of quality checks in NVDB in a more visual and easy-to-understand way in one and the same view. Coverage: SE. Its keywords include NVDB, map service, karttjänst. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2020-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geodata-se.
